verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents its own scheduled Blob Storage Export for large data volumes and API/SDK querying. Its open-source, MIT-licensed self-hosting runs the same infrastructure as Cloud, which supports the ability to leave with your data. However, the evidence never names the export formats or confirms that every data type (prompts, datasets, scores, traces) is covered, and one hands-on user found the retrieval API too slow for bulk scanning and queried the database directly. Missing for 10: explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/Parquet), documented complete-coverage export of all entities, a migration/offboarding guide, independent corroboration that bulk export works well.
